method: Selected chronology, ordered by update or event date within each extension; vertical spacing is not elapsed time. Forecasts retain the original date precision. Completion, testing and passenger service are different milestones. No lateness calculation, percentage-complete score or causal attribution to the mayor. Inherited schedules are context, not campaign deadlines. Status reflects the latest dated evidence retained, not live verification.
